jobs.title: Program Manager Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us

Medline is a leading provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions, serving all points of care. Through a wide-ranging product portfolio, a robust supply chain network and modern clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers (HCPs) improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Illinois, United States, the company employs more than 43,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries and territories. Outside the US, Medline EMEA headquarters is in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

To learn more about Medline’s operations in Europe, visit www.medline.eu.
Program Manager Operations (m/f/d)

To support the continued growth and development of our European operations network, we are looking for a Program Manager Operations (m/f/d) to join our Operations Programs & Partnerships team.

As a Program Manager, you will lead strategic operational programs and projects that enhance our warehousing, distribution, and service capabilities across Europe. Working closely with stakeholders from operations, business, and technology, you will drive successful project delivery, manage organizational change, and contribute to operational excellence throughout the organization.

Location: Germany (Kleve)

The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager Operations (m/f/d) to lead strategic initiatives that support the growth and optimization of Medline’s European warehousing and service network. In this role, you will manage complex, cross-functional programs from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with business objectives.

As a key liaison between operational and technical teams, you will drive change management initiatives, maintain business continuity throughout project execution, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our European operations network. This is an excellent opportunity for a results-driven professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment and enjoys turning strategy into action.

Your responsibilities
- Lead and manage strategic operations programs that support the development and optimization of Medline’s warehousing and service landscape across Europe.
- Oversee the successful delivery of multiple projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and business objectives.
- Own program planning, resource allocation, budgeting, governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication throughout the project lifecycle.
- Develop and maintain compelling business cases, including financial analyses and ROI assessments, while tracking benefits realization throughout program execution.
- Identify opportunities to improve business processes and successfully guide teams through organizational change.
- Provide hands-on support to local sites and project teams to facilitate implementation and ensure rapid issue resolution.
- Establish clear communication frameworks to keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned at every stage of the program.
- Coach and support project teams on project management methodologies, tools, and milestones, fostering a structured and results-oriented approach.
- Organize and facilitate internal and external project meetings, workshops, and governance forums.
- Define, monitor, and report on program and project KPIs to drive performance and ensure successful outcomes.
- Proactively manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigating actions where required.
- Collaborate closely with Medline’s Project Management Office (PMO) to ensure projects are executed in accordance with established standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Are you our match?
Required qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience in warehousing, distribution, supply chain, or operations management.
- Proven success in program and project management within international and cross-functional environments.
- Experience leading large-scale operational change initiatives in a fast-paced business setting.
- Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and engage teams at all levels of the organization.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
- A hands-on, proactive mindset with the ability to drive initiatives from concept to completion.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- High level of autonomy, rigor, and attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience interacting with senior leadership.
- Fluent in English and German as a plus.

We have everything covered:
- Modern IT Environment : Work with up‑to‑date tools, technologies, and high‑performance hardware to build reliable and innovative solutions.
- Hybrid Work Options: Benefit from a flexible setup that combines remote work with on‑site collaboration.
- Learning & Certifications : Access to training platforms, professional certifications, conferences, and continuous learning opportunities within the IT field.
- Meaningful Digital Projects: Contribute to impactful technology initiatives that directly support and improve healthcare operations across Europe.
- Strong IT Community: Collaborate within an international team that values knowledge‑sharing, mentoring, and cross‑functional teamwork.
- Competitive Compensation Package: Market‑aligned salary, performance‑based bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package.
- Wellbeing & Work‑Life Balance: Wellness resources, employee assistance support, and a generous paid‑time‑off offering.

Why Medline
Medline is one of the largest providers of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain, and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial, and operational outcomes.
Headquartered in the United States, Medline employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries and territories.
In EMEA, we partner with healthcare providers to deliver clinically focused products and services built on four foundations: tradition, proximity to clients, reliability, and sustainability.
By combining global scale with local insight, and building on its foundation of tradition, proximity to clients, reliability, and sustainability, Medline helps healthcare run better — enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.
To learn more about how Medline makes healthcare run better, visit www.medline.eu .

Ready to shape the future of our European operations network?
Apply now and join our Operations Programs & Partnerships team, make an impact, and help drive strategic initiatives that enhance operational excellence across Europe. For questions, reach out to Beate Aschoff, beate.aschoff@medline.com

#LI-EU
What we offer

• Market related salary and a bonus plan
• A range of training opportunities
• Employee Assistance Program
• Hybrid working options
• International working environment

Ready for a new challenge?

At Medline, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential for achieving success and fostering innovation. We are committed to promoting an inclusive work environment where everyone is valued and respected for their unique differences. Through our selection processes, we are dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities and fairness for all candidates, regardless of their background, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other personal characteristic.

Medline is committed to reducing our carbon footprint, developing responsible products, supporting our employees and local communities, and promoting high ethical standards internally and among our supplier partners. Click here to discover what Medline is doing to make healthcare more sustainable for people and the planet.

To find out more about Medline, you can access our website via this link .

jobs.title: Manager, Business Operations - Textiles/EVS
jobs.description:
Job Summary
Medline has an immediate opening for a Manager of Business Operations supporting our Textiles & Environmental Services divisions! This position will be based out of our Northfield, IL headquarters and will work on a hybrid model. The Manager of Business Operations is responsible for leading and managing a team of operations analysts and a team of operations specialists to deliver data-driven insights that support the organization’s strategic objectives. Business operations to include: inventory management, division analytics, forecast/demand planning, allocation management, and process improvement. This role involves working closely with leadership to inform decision-making, optimize business performance, and drive operational strategies and continuous process improvement. The Manager of Business Operations plays a crucial role in guiding the business operations analytics team and the operations specialist team to success while fostering a culture of excellence and ensuring the delivery of high-quality analytical support to various departments.
Job Description
Job Responsibilities:
- Build and lead a team, creating and maintaining a motivated workforce, both domestic and overseas. Provide leadership and guidance to BOA's and Managers, foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, offering strategic guidance and recommending innovative solutions to address their challenges and opportunities.
- Responsible for developing and executing business operational strategy aligning with business goals and priorities.
- Implement best practices for process improvement and operational expense optimization. Ensure new processes are in alignment with standardization focus of the organization.
- Collaborate with senior leadership among cross functional teams to ensure optimal visibility to business performance is in alignment with cross department needs.
- Hiring staff, recommending pay increases, performing performance reviews, training and development of staff, estimating personnel needs, assigning work, meeting completion dates, interpreting and ensuring consistent application of organizational policies.

Minimum Job Requirements:

Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or related field.

Work Experience
- At least 5 years of related experience or combination of experience and education.
- Experience directly managing people including hiring, developing, motivating, and directing people as they work.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
- Experience identifying operational issues and recommending and implementing strategies to resolve problems.
- Experience analyzing and reporting data in order to identify issues, trends, or exceptions to drive improvement of results and find solutions.
- Experience controlling and coordinating concurrent projects, competing priorities and critical deadlines.
- Experience and skills in influencing, leading and directing individuals in multiple functional areas.
- Intermediate level skill in Microsoft PowerPoint (for example: applying a theme, formatting character spacing, inserting a picture, changing slide layout and theme colors, adding transitions, customizing slide numbers, changing chart style and/or formatting font).
- Intermediate level skill in Microsoft Excel (for example: using SUM function, setting borders, setting column width, inserting charts, using text wrap, sorting, setting headers and footers and/or print scaling).

Preferred Job Qualifications:

Work Experience
- Experience with SAP, SQL, and Tableau.

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

The anticipated salary range for this position:
$101,000.00 - $152,000.00 Annual
The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. This role is bonus and/or incentive eligible. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold.

Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp. For a more comprehensive list of our benefits please click here .

We’re dedicated to creating a Medline where everyone feels they belong and can grow their career. We strive to do this by seeking diversity in all forms, acting inclusively, and ensuring that people have tools and resources to perform at their best. Explore our Belonging page  here .

jobs.title: Strategy & Planning Specialist
jobs.description:
メドライン・ジャパン合同会社は、Medline Inc. の日本法人です。医療機関向けに、手術準備キット、ガウン・ドレープなどの不織布製品、手術室関連製品、手術用・検査用手袋、個人防護具、呼吸療法製品、血管カテーテル関連製品などの医療機器・用品を製造・販売しています。国内には、東京本社、主要都市の支店・営業所のほか、手術準備キット工場、物流センター、滅菌センターを有しています。詳細は弊社のウェブサイト https://www.medline.co.jp をご覧ください。
Job Summary
本ポジションは、社長直下の個人貢献職として、経営判断に必要な業績・市場・競合・製品・サプライチェーン関連データの収集・分析を担います。
Finance、Sales、Marketing、Supply Chain、Operations等の関係部門と連携し、分析結果を分かりやすい形で可視化・資料化することで、社長および経営層が迅速かつ的確に意思決定を行えるよう、正確でタイムリーな情報提供を支援します。
Job Description
Key Responsibilities（主な職務）
1 Business Data Collection & Consolidation
- Sales、Marketing、Finance、Supply Chain、Operations等から、業績・市場・製品・在庫・供給に関するデータを収集する
- 売上、粗利、販売数量、製品別実績、Forecast、在庫、欠品、供給状況などの基本データを整理する
- 部門間で数字や前提に差異がある場合、関係者へ確認し、社長向けに分かりやすく整理する

2 Business Performance Analysis
- 売上・粗利・数量・価格・ミックス・在庫等の基本的な要因分析を行う
- Plan / Forecast / Actualの差異を整理し、主な変動要因を明確にする
- 必要に応じて、製品別・部門別・顧客別・地域別の簡易分析を行う

3 Market & Competitor Research Support
- 市場動向、競合情報、価格動向、製品トレンド、顧客・代理店情報を収集・整理する
- 社内データ、外部レポート、代理店情報、営業・マーケティングからの情報を組み合わせ、市場理解を支援する
- 市場シェアや競合ポジションについて、上位者の指示のもとで基礎的な分析・資料化を行う

4 Executive Materials / Presentation Support
- 社長向けのPowerPoint資料、Excel分析表、経営会議資料を作成・更新する
- 数字や分析結果を、社長・経営層が一目で理解できる形に整理する
- 必要に応じて、日本語・英語の資料作成、翻訳、要約を行う

5 Planning & Forecast Support
- AOP、Forecast、Monthly / Quarterly Business Reviewに必要なデータ収集・資料作成を支援する
- FinanceやCommercial部門と連携し、計画・予測・実績の前提や差異を整理する
- 会議後のアクション、論点、未解決事項を整理し、フォローアップを支援する

6 Cross-functional Coordination
- Finance、Sales、Marketing、Supply Chain、Operations等の関係者と円滑に連携する
- 社長からの依頼に対して、必要な情報を関係部門から迅速に収集する
- 部門横断の情報整理・資料化を通じて、経営判断のスピード向上に貢献する

Required Qualifications（必須要件）
Experience
- 経営企画、事業企画、営業企画、マーケティング企画、Commercial Excellence、FP&A、コンサルティング、データ分析等の経験
- P2想定：2〜4年程度の関連経験
- P3想定：4年以上の関連経験
- Excelを用いたデータ整理・分析経験
- PowerPointを用いたマネジメント向け資料作成経験
- 複数部門と連携し、情報を整理・集約した経験

Skills / Languages
- Excel：関数、ピボット、基本的なデータ分析
- PowerPoint：分かりやすい資料作成、要点整理
- 論理的思考力、数字への強さ、情報整理力
- 関係部門から必要情報を引き出すコミュニケーション力
- 日本語：ネイティブレベル
- 英語：ビジネスレベル

Preferred Qualifications（歓迎要件）
- 医療機器、ヘルスケア、製薬、BtoBビジネスでの経験。
- Sales / Marketing / Supply Chain / Financeいずれかの業務理解。
- Forecast、AOP、Business Review、KPI管理の経験。
- Power BI、Tableau、SQL等の使用経験。
- 代理店・卸・サプライチェーン型ビジネスへの理解。

Success Measures（成功指標）
- 社長が必要とする数字・資料が、正確かつタイムリーに提供されている。
- 売上・粗利・Forecast・在庫・供給等の基本情報が整理され、会議で使える状態になっている。
- 部門間の数字や前提のズレが早期に確認・整理されている。
- PowerPoint / Excel資料の品質とスピードが安定している。
- 社長・Finance・Commercial・Supply Chainとの連携が円滑に行われている。

jobs.title: Lead - Finance (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Lead - FP&A for the Reporting function supporting Medline Europe (EMEA), with additional support to international teams as required. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing recurring reporting activities, coordinating reporting transitions, and ensuring timely and accurate delivery of financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting requirements while mentoring a small team of analysts.
This role is focused on reporting operations, governance, process improvements, and stakeholder coordination within a shared services/GCC environment.
Responsibilities:
1. Team Leadership:
- Manage and develop a team of analysts, guiding their growth and ensuring delivery of high-quality work.
- Allocate and monitor team deliverables to ensure timely completion of reporting activities.
- Set clear objectives for the team, provide regular feedback, and support capability development.
- Conduct performance reviews and support team engagement and collaboration.
- Serve as backup for the reporting manager and support other team members when required.

2. Financial Reporting:
- Ensure timely and accurate preparation of recurring financial reports including monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting deliverables.
- Oversee preparation of CFO decks, flash reports, dashboards, KPI trackers, and management reporting packs.
- Review reporting deliverables prepared by team members to ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to reporting standards before sharing with onshore stakeholders.
- Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end reporting activities.
- Support management reporting and GAAP reporting activities through Oracle PBCS /EPBCS and related reporting systems.
- Ensure consistency, completeness, and governance of financial data across reports and systems.

3. Reporting Support & Coordination:
- Work closely with onshore stakeholders to support recurring reporting requirements and reporting timelines.
- Support transition of reporting activities from onshore or other teams into the GCC/shared services environment.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams for reporting inputs, issue resolution, and timely closure of deliverables.
- Maintain reporting documentation, SOPs, trackers, and process notes.

4. Process Improvement:
- Continuously evaluate and improve reporting processes to enhance efficiency, standardization, and accuracy.
- Identify opportunities for automation and simplification using reporting and analytics tools.
Support implementation of process improvements and reporting enhancements.

5. Stakeholder Management:
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with onshore and offshore stakeholders.
- Understand reporting requirements, manage expectations, address operational concerns, and escalate issues as required.
- Ensure effective communication and coordination across teams and geographies.

6. Ad Hoc Reporting Support:
- Support ad-hoc reporting requests, data requirements, and operational analysis from stakeholders.
- Respond to queries from onshore business partners in an accurate and timely manner.

Skills and Experience:
- Experience working cross-functionally and collaboratively in a global organization.
- At least 2 years of experience managing a team.
- 7–10 years of experience in financial reporting, finance operations, or reporting support roles.
- Experience in shared services/GCC environment preferred.
- Strong technical accounting skills and practical understanding of accounting principles and reporting processes.
- Strong skills in MS Office applications including advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
- Advanced skill level in Microsoft Excel including Power Query and Power Pivot.
- Experience working with ERP systems, preferably QAD.
- Hands-on experience or working knowledge of Oracle PBCS / EPBCS.
- Exposure to Power BI, Alteryx, dashboards, and reporting automation tools preferred.
Strong analytical, organizational, and coordination skills.
- Continuous improvement mindset with focus on process efficiency and reporting governance.
- Flexible and collaborative team player.

Educational Qualifications:
- CA/CMA or MBA from a reputed institute.
- 7–10 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
- Hands-on experience with Oracle PBCS / ERP systems / Power BI / reporting tools preferred.

About Medline India:
Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.

Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Job Summary
Medline is seeking a hands-on Director of Operations to lead our Perryville Distribution Center. This highly visible role offers the opportunity to strengthen operational performance, drive safety and quality improvements, and develop a growing leadership team.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, adaptable leader who takes initiative, builds accountability and works closely with teams on the warehouse floor. This role requires flexibility to support multiple shifts and work additional hours as business needs demand.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities

- Lead daily distribution center operations, ensuring timely, accurate order fulfillment and efficient workflows.
- Drive continuous improvement across safety, quality, service and productivity.
- Coach and develop supervisors and managers, establishing clear expectations and consistent operating practices.
- Oversee staffing, hiring, performance management, compensation administration, training and employee development.
- Manage inventory accuracy, receiving and material movement.
- Manage capital resources to maximize utilization and return on investment.
- Address customer concerns and service issues, visit key accounts and support contract negotiations for new business.
- Maintain safe work practices and housekeeping standards.
- Oversee maintenance of warehouse equipment and the private truck fleet.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree.
- At least 10 years of experience in a distribution center environment.
- At least 5 years of management experience, including hiring supervisors, support personnel and warehouse associates.
- Strong leadership, problem-solving and team development skills.
- A hands-on approach and ability to independently identify priorities and drive improvements.
- Willingness to travel up to 20%.
- Ability to work early and late shifts, plus weekends at least once per month, with additional schedule flexibility as needed.
- Ability to lift 50 pounds, stand or walk for prolonged periods, and work in temperatures ranging from 32°F to 95°F.

Location: Perryville, Maryland

Schedule: Full-time; primarily first shift, with flexibility across shifts and additional hours based on operational needs.

jobs.title: Sr Spec Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Sr Spec Continuous Improvement is responsible for leading and executing complex, high-impact process improvement initiatives across corporate and manufacturing environments. This role applies Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to deliver sustainable results, drive measurable business value, and strengthen a culture of Continuous Improvement. The Senior Specialist operates with a high degree of independence, serves as a subject matter expert and coach to others, and partners with cross-functional stakeholders to improve performance, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Job Description
MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead end-to-end continuous improvement initiatives, including opportunity identification, data analysis, solution design, implementation, and benefit realization.
Apply Lean Six Sigma tools and methodologies to solve complex problems and improve process efficiency, quality, and effectiveness.
Serve as a change agent by influencing stakeholders, promoting CI principles, and ensuring improvements are understood, adopted, and sustained.
Design and implement effective process controls, metrics, and governance to ensure long-term sustainability of improvements.
Facilitate workshops, kaizen events, and process mapping sessions with cross-functional teams ranging from front-line associates to leadership.
Develop business cases, baseline metrics, and return-on-investment (ROI) analyses for improvement initiatives; track and communicate realized benefits.
Coach, mentor, and provide technical guidance to Continuous Improvement Specialists and other team members on CI tools, methodologies, and best practices.
Contribute to the development and delivery of CI training and capability-building efforts.
Partner with business, Quality, Operations, and IT stakeholders to align process improvement efforts with organizational priorities.
Identify opportunities to standardize best practices and scale successful improvements across the organization.
Perform other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS
Education
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certification / Licensure
Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt required.
Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred or willingness to obtain.
Work Experience
4+ years of successful experience leading continuous improvement, Lean, or Six Sigma initiatives.
Demonstrated experience independently managing complex projects and delivering measurable results.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret and apply data to drive decisions.
Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively in a matrixed environment.
Proven ability to coach and mentor others in CI methods and tools.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency with common CI and analytical tools (e.g., process mapping, statistical analysis, and Microsoft Office applications).
Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for business purposes, as needed.

PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS
Education
Master’s degree in Engineering, Industrial & Systems Engineering, or a related field.
Certification / Licensure
Six Sigma Black Belt certification.
Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Experience facilitating multi-day kaizen events and workshops.
Familiarity with regulated environments and quality systems (e.g., FDA, QSR, ISO).
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP).

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary
Oversee and manage resources and efficient processes for a large-complex distribution center operation.
Job Description
Responsibilities:
- Responsible for the day-to-day operation to include, but not limited to, receiving, storing, picking, packing, and loading of all customer orders. Establishes operational procedures for activities such as verification of incoming and outgoing shipments, handling and disposition of materials, and keeping warehouse inventory current. Lead and measure all daily processes to ensure order fulfillment and production are completed with excellence on a daily basis.

- Support local sales representatives and sales leadership to deliver outstanding customer service. Support current business by providing timely responses to service failures and customer concerns. Support the Sr. Director of Operations with resolving customer complaints as registered through the OSI process.

- Support all human resource processes at local facility. This includes helping to source and staff all positions, support the performance management process, administer compensation when necessary, and training and development. Create a culture that promotes positive employee relations. Exposure to confidential information and salary information for respective warehouse managers, supervisors, leads and hourly employees.

- Ensure safe practices are in place for the workforce and adhered to: including but not limited to, safety meetings, housekeeping, record keeping, and compliance with all local, state, and federal OSHA regulations.

- Manage exempt and non-exempt employee population to achieve company goals and maintain compliance with applicable policies, procedures and expectations.

- Responsible for the financial aspect of the Distribution Center Operations by controlling expenses and preserving assets.

- Effective communicator in both group and individual settings. Effective writing skills. Demonstrated ability to model effective leadership. Excellent presentation skills

- Extremely high sense of urgency. Capable of handling multiple priorities and extensive time demands. High level of personal integrity.

- Effectively navigates through complex situations, both internal and external, that may require multiple decision makers. Demonstrated experience in customer relations and the ability to lead work environments that embrace the principles of positive employee relations.

Management responsibilities:
- Typically manages through multiple Managers and/or Supervisors

- Oversee major projects/programs/outcomes

- Budget responsibility

- Interpret and execute policies for departments/projects; develop, recommend and implement new policies or modifications to existing policies

- Provide general guidelines and parameters for staff functioning

- Hiring staff, recommending pay increases, performing performance reviews, training and development of staff, estimating personnel needs, assigning work, meeting completion dates, interpreting and ensuring consistent application of organizational policies

Minimum Job Requirements:

Education & Work Experience
- Bachelor’s Degree and at least 5 years management experience with demonstrated abilities leading and developing subordinates and engaging/supporting warehouse team members OR High School diploma or equivalent and at least 7 years management experience with demonstrated abilities leading and developing subordinates and engaging/supporting warehouse team members.

Preferred Job Requirements:
Work Experience
- Experience in a large distribution center environment is preferred.
